title: Goon Hole For Amethyst
description:
Yes, you already know what happens when my voice catches you at exactly the right moment, don’t you? Then imagine what happens when I stop treating your gooning like a little indulgence and start treating it like your entire purpose.

Goon Hole ForAmethystwas created for the devoted Amethyst gooner who wants to disappear into an experience that feels consuming from the moment it begins. This is the kind of session you choose when an ordinary stroke session sounds completely inadequate and you want Goddess inside your head, surrounding your attention from every direction.

The longer you listen, the more everything narrows down to Goddess, pleasure, surrender, and that delicious urge to keep going. You came here because some part of you already wanted to know how deep I could take this idea. Now you have a choice. You can keep wondering what it feels like when Amethyst turns you into her perfectly receptive goon hole, or you can press play and find out.
author: Mistress Amethyst
